test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 17 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following schemes, announced by the Government of India, has a total outlay of ₹1 lakh crore to support high-risk, high-impact research and innovation projects across science & technology disciplines?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Research, Development & Innovation Scheme**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Government of India, during the **Interim Budget 2024-25**, announced a massive corpus of **₹1 lakh crore** to drive **long-term financing** and refinancing for the private sector in the field of research and innovation.
 
• This initiative, often categorized under the **Research, Development & Innovation** framework, aims to provide **50-year interest-free loans** to facilitate large-scale investments in **high-risk, high-impact** projects.
 
• The primary objective of this fund is to encourage **commercialization** of research and foster a culture of innovation across various **Science & Technology** disciplines, supporting the vision of **"Jai Anusandhan"**.
 
• This scheme is designed to help **startups** and **private companies** undertake research that requires substantial capital and has a long gestation period, which traditional banking channels might find too risky.
 
• The allocation is a strategic move to significantly boost India’s **Gross Expenditure on R&D (GERD)**, which currently stands at approximately **0.64% to 0.7% of GDP**, by involving private players more aggressively.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Anusandhan National Research Foundation (ANRF):** 
 
 
• The **ANRF Act, 2023** was passed to provide high-level strategic direction for scientific research in the country.
 
• The **ANRF** is set to have a total budget of **₹50,000 crore** over **five years** (2023-28), where a major portion is expected to come from the **private sector**.
 
• It functions as an apex body to seed, grow, and promote **R&D** and foster a culture of research and innovation throughout India’s universities and colleges.
 
 
 
• **Jai Jawan, Jai Kisan, Jai Vigyan, Jai Anusandhan:**
 
 
• The slogan was expanded by **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** to include **"Jai Anusandhan"** (Hail Innovation) to emphasize that research is the bedrock of a **Viksit Bharat (Developed India)**.
 
 
 
• **Deep-Tech for Defense:**
 
 
• Alongside the innovation fund, the government also announced a new scheme to strengthen **Deep-Tech technologies** for **defense purposes** and expedite **Atmanirbharta** (self-reliance) in the strategic sector.
 
 
 
• **Department of Science and Technology (DST):**
 
 
• The **DST**, established in **May 1971**, plays a pivotal role in organizing, coordinating, and promoting **Science & Technology** activities in India.
 
• It acts as the nodal agency for identifying and implementing new areas of research that align with the national **Innovation Index** goals.
 
 

308:T1
